query: select count(distinct fp.player_id)::bigint as "count!" from formation_players fp where exists ( select 1 from formation_events code_posted where code_posted.formation_id = fp.formation_id and code_posted.kind = $1 ) and not exists ( select 1 from match_reports mr where mr.formation_id = fp.formation_id and mr.player_id = fp.player_id ) and not exists ( select 1 from formation_events exempt where exempt.formation_id = fp.formation_id and exempt.kind = any($2) )
